cases.question: Show the titles of the newest 7 episodes.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT title FROM episodes ORDER BY air_date DESC LIMIT 7

cases.question: Show episodes from seasons 3 through 6.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM episodes WHERE season BETWEEN 3 AND 6

cases.question: How many episodes are in each season?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT season, COUNT(*) FROM episodes GROUP BY season

cases.question: Show the seasons with more than 10 episodes.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT season, COUNT(*) FROM episodes GROUP BY season HAVING COUNT(*) > 10

cases.question: Show the 10 heaviest players born in the USA.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM players WHERE birth_country = 'USA' ORDER BY weight DESC LIMIT 10

cases.question: Show the 20 largest salaries from 2001.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT salary FROM salaries WHERE year = 2001 ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 20

cases.question: For each year, what was the highest home run total?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT year, MAX(HR) FROM performances GROUP BY year

cases.question: Which years had a maximum home run total above 60?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT year, MAX(HR) FROM performances GROUP BY year HAVING MAX(HR) > 60

cases.question: Show charter schools in Boston ordered alphabetically.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM schools WHERE type = 'Charter School' AND city = 'Boston' ORDER BY name ASC

cases.question: Show the 10 highest per-pupil expenditures.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT per_pupil_expenditure FROM expenditures ORDER BY per_pupil_expenditure DESC LIMIT 10

cases.question: Show records with graduation above 90 and dropout below 5.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM graduation_rates WHERE graduated > 90 AND dropped < 5

cases.question: How many districts are there of each type?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT type, COUNT(*) FROM districts GROUP BY type
